_route.brief: A medicine shop: it buys medical goods and lots that are mostly medical (injectors, salves, blood bags, surgical tools), passes on the rest, and fills the case with them for the hospital buyers. The Appraisal Board pays the rent; the reference kit (a small cellar, a furnace, vending) runs on the side. Bought for cash around day 100–105, a week behind the generalist.
